issues.description: The text 'CROMANCER' is partially visible and appears to be a fragment of a larger word, likely 'NECROMANCER', which is also present in full below an image. This suggests a rendering issue where part of the text is cut off or misaligned.
The 'WARRIOR' card on the far right has its description text cut off at the bottom, making it unreadable. The text spills outside the visible area of the card.
The 'BATTLEMAGE' card on the far left has its description text cut off at the bottom, making it unreadable. The text spills outside the visible area of the card.

The text 'THE ROOT-BINDER' is partially obscured by the icon above it.  [and 7 more like it]

The mini-map UI element in the top right corner has a '?' icon and an 'H' character rendered on top of what appears to be a blank or missing map image, indicating placeholder or missing art.
The text 'SWORD' and 'DUSKFANG' in the bottom left corner are rendered with very low contrast against their dark background, making them hard to read.
The text 'YOUR TURN' above the 'End Turn' button is rendered with very low contrast against its dark background, making it hard to read.

The text 'SEALING LIGJIT' on one of the cards in the player's hand (fourth from the left) has a corrupted or misrendered 'H' character, showing as a 'J'.
The text 'SEATING LIGHT' on one of the cards in the player's hand (second from the right) has a corrupted or misrendered 'L' character, showing as a 'T'.
The text 'ROOT WA' on the far right card in the player's hand is clipped, the full word 'WARDEN' is not visible.
The text '34 DECK O BARROW' in the top right corner has a '0' instead of an 'OF' or '0' for the deck count, which looks like a placeholder or an error.

The 'End Turn' button has a small, faint, dark grey text 'YOUR TURN' rendered directly above it, which is hard to read due to low contrast against the dark background and also appears to be redundant or misplaced.
The text 'Dig Ch:' under 'Rewards' is cut off, indicating it spills outside its intended display area or is truncated.
The text 'Turns taken: 1' has a line rendered through it, making it difficult to read.
The text '34 DECK O BARROW' in the top right corner appears to have a '0' instead of an 'OF' or similar, which looks like a placeholder or garbled text.
The text 'DUSKEANG' below the card in the bottom left appears to be a misspelling of 'DUSKFANG' or similar, suggesting a garbled glyph or typo.
The text 'Rewards forfeited' is partially obscured by the red line that is rendered on top of it, making it difficult to read the word 'forfeited'.
The text '+EMBER:1' under 'Fragments' is rendered with a colon that is partially cut off, appearing as '+EMBER.1' or similar, which could be misread.
The text 'Return to Map' in the button is slightly cut off on the right side, specifically the 'p' in 'Map' is very close to the edge of the button.
The text 'VERD' in the filter options is partially obscured by the 'ALL' filter, making it difficult to read.  [and 4 more like it]
The text 'CINDER RUNNER' on the card is difficult to read due to low contrast against the dark background of the card art.  [and 2 more like it]
The scrollbar on the right side of the screen is very thin and difficult to see, potentially impacting usability.
The overall layout of the content is severely unbalanced, with a large empty space in the middle and content crammed into the top and bottom, making it look unfinished.
